judgement.rule: A box is offered in a Damage-tab step only where its WHEN gives it: the box's kind (melee / ranged / all) and, for a stratagem, its phases / turn / turns unless its effect lasts the turn, round or battle (lasts). Not offered otherwise (no "yours to count anyway"); a saved tick of one counts nothing. Every mod passed to calc.js carries attacks (melee / ranged / none) and calc.js never counts it for the other kind.
judgement.before: a Fight-only stratagem in the Shooting step (and a Shooting one in the fight) was shown "<phase> phase only · yours to count anyway" and, ticked, applied to the other kind of weapons
